name: @elementspanel/epanel-plugin-mcsm-market
description: 上游 MCSM 的应用商城组件

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const path = require('node:path'); const { isBuiltin } = require('node:module'); const esbuild = require('esbuild'); const vue = require('@vitejs/plugin-vue');  const root = process.cwd(); const metadata = require('./package.json'); const shared = [ 'vue', 'vue-router', 'pinia', 'vue-i18n', 'cordis', 'cosmokit', '@vueuse/core', '@vueuse/shared', '@elements-panel/sdk' ];  async function build() { const { build: frontendBuild } = await import('vite'); for (const side of ['panel', 'daemon']) { if (!metadata.elementspanel[side]) continue; const definition = metadata.elementspanel[side]; const directory = path.join(root, definition.directory); const filename = path.join(directory, 'plugin.json'); const manifest = { backend: 'backend/index.cjs' }; fs.rmSync(path.join(directory, 'backend'), { recursive: true, force: true }); const backend = await esbuild.build({ entryPoints: [path.join(directory, 'src/backend/index.ts')], outfile: path.join(directory, 'backend/index.cjs'), bundle: true, platform: 'node', format: 'cjs', target: 'node22', tsconfig: path.join(root, 'tsconfig.json'), metafile: true, packages: 'external' }); for (const output of Object.values(backend.metafile.outputs)) { for (const dependency of output.imports.filter((item) => item.external)) { const id = dependency.path; if (isBuiltin(id)) continue; const name = id.startsWith('@') ? id.split('/').slice(0, 2).join('/') : id.split('/')[0]; if (!metadata.dependencies?.[name]) throw new Error(('Undeclared runtime dependency: ' + (name))); } } if (side === 'panel') { const result = await frontendBuild({ configFile: false, root: directory, plugins: [vue()], build: { outDir: path.join(directory, 'frontend'), emptyOutDir: true, sourcemap: false, rollupOptions: { input: path.join(directory, 'src/frontend.ts'), preserveEntrySignatures: 'strict', external: (id) => shared.some((name) => id === name || id.startsWith(((name) + '/'))), output: { format: 'es', entryFileNames: 'index.js', chunkFileNames: '[name]-[hash].js', assetFileNames: (asset) => asset.name?.endsWith('.css') ? 'assets/style.css' : 'assets/[name]-[hash][extname]' } } } }); manifest.frontend = 'frontend/index.js'; const styles = result.output .filter((item) => item.type === 'asset' && item.fileName.endsWith('.css')) .map((item) => ('frontend/' + (item.fileName))) .sort(); if (styles.length) definition.styles = styles; else delete definition.styles; const entry = result.output.find((item) => item.type === 'chunk' && item.isEntry); if (!entry?.exports.includes('apply')) throw new Error('Frontend plugin must export apply.'); } fs.writeFileSync(filename, ((JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)) + '\n')); } fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'package.json'), ((JSON.stringify(metadata, null, 2)) + '\n')); console.log(('Built ' + (metadata.name) + '@' + (metadata.version))); }  build().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });"
